appliesTo: 港鐵市區綫成人八達通單程
appliesToEn: MTR urban lines adult Octopus single journey
source: MTR Adult Octopus / Adult QR / Adult Contactless fare chart PDF (adu_chd_ocl_mtr_fare_2024.pdf), offline extract for stations in stations.json
notes: Effective from 30 June 2024 per MTR published chart
Matrix covers OD pairs among the 42 stations in stations.json (859/861 undirected pairs)
Intentionally no fare for Central↔Hong Kong and Tsim Sha Tsui↔East Tsim Sha Tsui (out-of-gate walk transfers; not priced as MTR rides in this chart)
UI disables destinations with no fare when the other end is already selected
Regenerate with: py -3 scripts/extract_octopus_fares.py (requires local PDF at %TEMP%\mtr_octopus_fare_2024.pdf)
